newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, market seen as growing. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, market seen as growing. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday but traders predicted shares to maintain their upward momentum.
"The bull run will continue for some time to come. The expected monthly growth of profit rates between 10 and 20 percent is certainly very high," Veronika Reskovac of Karlovacka Banka told Reuters.
* Of 10 active issues six were up, two fell and two were flat.
* Most actively traded, food processor Podravka, added five kuna to 255 with 6,278 shares sold (corrects by inserting dropped text).
* The biggest gainers were two hoteliers.
- Istarturist was up 25 kuna to 185, selling 219 shares.
- Jadranturist gained 10 kuna to 270, trading 328 shares.
* Cable-maker Elka rose 8 kuna to 193 on volume of 212.
* Zagrebacka Banka gained 50 kuna to 1,000 and 1,245 shares changed hands.
* Confectioner Kras edged up 0.50 kuna, closing at 530.50 on volume of 639 (corrects from 6,278) shares.
* Drugs firm Pliva closed 100 kuna down at 13,100 after peaking at 13,200 kuna, but only 27 shares were traded.
* Hotelier Zlatni Rat, which last traded in August, lost eight kuna to 110 on volume of 88 shares.
- Arenaturist was flat at 100 kuna trading 345 units.
- Laguna traded at 905 kuna on volume of 154.
* Turnover down at 6.9 million, volume also lower at 9,636.
